gloss: outsourcing; contracting out work; freelance contract

definitions.gloss: outsourcing; contracting out work; working as a contractor
definitions.explanation: Entrusting a task to an outside company or individual under a contract, rather than having employees do it; also the arrangement under which a freelancer works for a client.

examples.japanese: {業務委託|ぎょうむいたく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{業務委託|ぎょうむいたく}している。
examples.english: We contract out the cleaning to an outside company.

examples.japanese: {業務委託|ぎょうむいたく}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧ではないので、⟦{社会保険|しゃかいほけん}→社会保険：18894_shakaihoken⟧や⟦{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧にならない。
examples.english: A contracting agreement is not employment, so it doesn't come with social insurance or paid leave.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業務委託|ぎょうむいたく}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧: a contracting agreement
- {業務委託|ぎょうむいたく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a contractor
- {業務委託|ぎょうむいたく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to contract out (a task)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外注|がいちゅう}→外注：12153_gaichuu⟧: outsourcing — the everyday word for ordering work from outside
- ⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧: agency staffing — the worker is employed by the agency, which {業務委託|ぎょうむいたく} is not
- ⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧: employment — the relationship {業務委託|ぎょうむいたく} stands outside of
